authorizes: nothing; this config has no runtime, no venue access, and no REAL_MONEY implication
claim: A long-only Bybit book that holds top-100 names while their settled funding is deeply negative (enter < -10 bp/8h, exit when it recovers above -3 bp/8h; per-name cap 0.10, total gross cap 1.0) earns the crowded-short funding premium plus squeeze pressure, net of settlement-exact funding and measured-turnover taker costs. Measured attribution over 2021-2026 is +13.06 units of capital from funding against -3.86 from price: the return IS collected funding, not a price anomaly. On the benchmark window (2023-03-13..2026-07-16) it earns Sharpe 2.76 raw / 2.98 vol-targeted versus the deployed CONTINUOUS sl35 render's 1.84, with t 4.70 on 1,059 days.

universe.note: ranked within each decision bar; 168h price history required (maturity implied by the momentum column of the shared prepare step)

state.signal: last settled funding rate at the decision bar (by_funding, age < 8h)
state.note: state at bar i uses settled funding at bars <= i only; decisions on the fixed 24h grid

sizing.gross_cap_note: without the cap the book trebles gross exactly during cascades (25 names qualified during LUNA week at 0.1 each); the cap dilutes cascades instead of levering into them

risk.note: scale for day t uses realized vol strictly before t; leverage-change turnover is charged

cost_model.charging: measured one-way turnover x fee per side, per day (mean one-way turnover 0.35 units/day, i.e. ~2.7 bp/day), NOT a flat round trip per period
cost_model.provenance: 7.78 bp/side measured 2026-07-25 from 85 forward demo fills (all taker); see liquidity_migration.cross_section.MEASURED_ROUND_TRIP_BP

scoring_recipe.metric: mean net bp per day, and annualised Sharpe on raw and vol-targeted daily series
scoring_recipe.comparator: the deployed CONTINUOUS sl35 render (Sharpe 1.84, +15.85% over 2023-03-13..2026-07-16) and zero
scoring_recipe.cadence: one row per completed UTC day after the registration commit
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only days strictly after the registration commit date count as forward evidence

benchmark_window_2023_03_13_to_2026_07_1.note: vol-targeted figures from the committed module, which charges leverage-change turnover; exploratory scripts without that charge report vt Sharpe 2.98

validation.binance_replication: same construction on Binance funding/prices: +25.04 bp/day, t 2.73, Sharpe 1.38 (bench vt 2.18); effect ratio 0.50, inside the 2A band [0.5, 2.0]. First positive mechanism in this program to survive cross-venue replication. corr(bybit, binance daily nets) = +0.85.
validation.entry_delay: +1h: t 4.19; +4h: t 4.82 (no stale-print artifact; the mechanism is slow)
validation.placebo: same days, same gross, top-100 basket instead of selected names: Sharpe 0.72 vs 2.76 -> the return is name selection, not market timing
validation.parameter_plateau: enter/exit thresholds {5/2, 10/3, 15/4, 20/5} all Sharpe 1.92-2.64; knife-filter variants {none, -30%, -40%, -50%} all 2.26-2.44; top-N {50, 100, 300} all 2.26-2.61. Broad plateau, no spike.
validation.multiple_testing: the 2026-07-26 program tested ~18 new mechanism families (~45 constructions) on top of the repository's ~45; Bonferroni threshold ~ t 3.4. This config's t 4.88 clears it.

measured_at_registration.provenance: Lane-1 exploration on 2021-01-01..2026-07-18 (both-venue cross_venue_panel_v1, commit a9ac75d) selected this configuration on 2026-07-26. These numbers CANNOT grade it; the forward record after the registration commit does. Full evidence note: docs/research_2026-07-26_financed_longs.md.

known_weaknesses: concentrated: mean ~3.8 names when active, active on ~72% of days; single-name idiosyncratic risk is bounded only by the 0.10 cap
correlated +0.75 with lane2_financed_leaders_v1 (both are funding-conditioned long-side books); they share one macro-premium, not independent bets
BTC correlation +0.30: the book is long-only and carries market beta on its active days; 2022 was still positive (+19.1 bp/day) because deployment is rare in grind-down regimes
2021 is thin (49 active days): deep-negative funding barely existed in that bull market; deployment frequency is regime-dependent
capacity: the deep-negative-funding subset of top-100 names; fine at the current account envelope, not a large-book claim
entering names in capitulation can catch death spirals (LUNA 2022-05 was entered); the gross cap dilutes but does not remove this - worst raw day -19.4%
the +71 bp/day 2026 era rides the structural funding inversion (docs/audit/2026-07-24 section 5); if funding normalizes the deployment frequency and edge shrink together
